infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Goflyp requires location access to calculate accurate campus road routes, detect nearby motorcycle pick-up gates, and coordinate student journeys.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Goflyp uses your location during active journeys to provide live route telemetry and campus security dispatch.
